bounded_leaf.tested_scope: Deterministic role-local synthetic fixtures only. No public sources, repository chronology beyond own current STATE, other-role state, O/downstream semantics, live rollback-guard backfill, real rollback, external effect, scheduler mutation, wait/retry, or second leaf was used.
bounded_leaf.model: A fresh generation Gnew and replay key Knew may authorize a candidate effect only after the generation is durably recorded, the replay mapping exists, checkpoint_published=true, and current_generation=expected_generation=replay_mapping_generation=Gnew with current_replay_key=Knew. Any missing publication stage or any superseding current generation fails closed before candidate adoption/effect.
bounded_leaf.admission_predicate: admit_before_candidate_effect iff generation_recorded=true AND replay_mapping_present=true AND checkpoint_published=true AND current_replay_key=Knew AND current_generation=expected_generation=replay_mapping_generation=Gnew.
bounded_leaf.result: All modeled crash cutpoints before full publication fail closed. The only admitted case is the fully published Knew->Gnew mapping while Gnew remains both current and expected. A competing writer that advances current generation before publication prevents the stale Gnew candidate from being adopted or producing an effect.
bounded_leaf.validated_property: Generation-bound replay admission can be made crash-cutpoint and supersession safe in the modeled state machine by requiring complete publication plus an equality check against the still-current expected generation immediately before candidate adoption/effect.
limitations: This synthetic model does not provide a concrete zero-quota allocator that guarantees non-reused generation identifiers under concurrent writers.
It does not prove atomicity of a real storage backend across generation record, replay mapping and publication marker writes.
It does not test CAS conflict handling, allocator collision, generation reuse/wraparound, or real external effects.
The live STATE still has no operational rollback_guard structure; this leaf intentionally did not backfill one.

missing_capability_child: A concrete zero-quota generation-allocation/publication mechanism that prevents same-predecessor concurrent writers from allocating an indistinguishable generation, resolves the losing writer without external arbitration, and preserves the modeled replay/publication fail-closed ordering remains unresolved.
